description: Default punch-card deck for Retro AI Workbench. token_estimate is UI-only; it is stripped from PocketBase writes.

cards.title: React Component Scaffold
cards.prompt: You are a senior React engineer. Scaffold a reusable data-table component with sorting, filtering, and pagination. TypeScript props, accessible markup, Tailwind styling. Output the complete component file plus a short usage example.

cards.title: Long-Context Document Processor
cards.prompt: Process the attached long document and produce: (1) a 5-bullet executive summary, (2) a list of action items with owners, (3) open questions. Keep the entire source in context; do not truncate.

cards.title: Test Case Writer
cards.prompt: Write a thorough suite of test cases for the described feature. Cover happy path, edge cases, error states, and boundary values. Format as a table: ID, description, preconditions, steps, expected result.

cards.title: PocketBase Schema Designer
cards.prompt: Design a PocketBase schema for a retro AI workbench app: collections, fields, relations, indexes, and view rules for public read / authenticated write. Include example JSON for each collection.

cards.title: Code Review Auditor
cards.prompt: Audit the provided code snippet for bugs, security issues, performance problems, and style violations. Rank findings by severity and suggest concrete fixes with code.
